contract.reader: Someone who builds or reviews web applications, HTTP APIs or back-end services and is deciding whether and where to start the series
contract.problem: Knowing what the seven entries cover, in what order and why, what they assume and what the reader will be able to do at the end
contract.outcome: Choose a starting point; know the prerequisites and shared conventions; have six checkable objectives
contract.contribution: An order that follows a request through a system (whole picture, who is asking, may they do this, delegation, binding, calls inside the system), stated in one paragraph
contract.evidence: The seven entries; each objective is delivered by at least one entry (checked in the live review)
contract.limitations: An overview; does not summarize entry content; total reading time not stated
